reviewed_contracts: New filtering only narrows full existing event_battle_links rows by exact scene_key and choice_key. No status/difficulty/alias rewriting is added.
No-battle or empty-scene selection keeps event_stage empty and battle button disabled; no fallback to event-wide battle rows.

Same event key restores full UserRole+1 origin tuple. Missing prior tuple becomes -1 even if the same stage_id exists for another choice; fresh different event preserves old initial-first-item compatibility.
select_stage revalidates current context by rebuilding and restoring exactly the selected tuple before emitting only its retained stage ID. Missing/failed source suppresses emission.
_event_preview_filter_changed touches only three preview comboboxes, visibility/button/status on error; neither reading document/tab/cursor/scroll nor map/run/dossier state is rewritten.
Non-event show_selected calls helper with event=None, then independently re-enables the direct-battle entry at its old caller guard; direct battle select_stage bypasses the event helper.
Only two intended production/test files are promoted; existing old test methods are not deleted, skipped or rewritten in this candidate.
Existing qualifications, ordinary dual variants, explicit emergency filtering, all six pursuit/event aliases, generic fourth tuple marker and unknown next-floor behavior are inherited unchanged.
nonblocking_validation_recommendations: Include old direct battle entry/button check in necessary validation; the helper finally temporarily disables the shared button before show_selected restores it.
Include one filtered but excluded-qualification source reference control; source row status must remain descriptive and not hide the fixed preview.
Keep a source-failure click control and a later valid-source recovery requiring explicit stage selection; no stale entry should auto-fire.
limits: Static review is not a Qt signal/runtime or actual native layout acceptance.
Exception handling in this new preview helper does not claim to make every pre-existing event text renderer immune to arbitrary global source errors.
